meta.name: offer-extraction
meta.description: Use when you need to turn a product or service into a compelling, high-converting offer. Trigger on "offer", "why would someone buy", "improve conversions", "value proposition".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品或服务转化为高转化率的营销方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提升产品或服务的购买转化率
copy.tagline_en: Turn your product or service into a high-converting offer
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to boost conversion rates for your product or service

howto.what: Claude 会分析你的产品或服务，提炼出吸引人的卖点，并生成多个“Offer Angles”（卖点角度）和一个“Dominant Offer”（主打卖点），最后附上“Why This, Why Now”（为何选它、为何现在行动）的说明。
howto.when: 当你提到“offer”、“why would someone buy”、“improve conversions”、“value proposition”等关键词，或要求优化产品/服务的转化率时触发。

say.text: 帮我提炼这个在线课程的核心卖点。
say.note: Claude 会分析课程并输出多个卖点角度。

say.text: 为什么客户应该现在购买我的 SaaS 产品？
say.note: Claude 会生成主打卖点和紧迫感理由。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes your product or service, extracts compelling selling points, and generates multiple 'Offer Angles' and a 'Dominant Offer' with a 'Why This, Why Now' explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'offer', 'why would someone buy', 'improve conversions', 'value proposition', or ask to optimize conversion of a product/service.

say_en.text: Extract the core selling points of this online course.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the course and output multiple angles.

say_en.text: Why should customers buy my SaaS product now?
say_en.note: Claude will generate a dominant offer and urgency reasons.
